answer: NMRC‟s technology transfer collaborations leverage research capabilities found in the public and private sectors to stretch research dollars and accomplish the mission of supporting the health and readiness of the military‟s men and women in uniform. The projects are enabling the country to independently expand vectorborne disease surveillance and detection capabilities in Liberia to benefit the Liberian Armed Forces as well as the entire population of Liberia
